selection: M5/M6 fail preregistered natural per-match loss gate on all development matches. No R7 candidate selected. Compare fixed first-fold R6 M1/M2/M3, trained J03WOH/J03WQQ; no all-data refit, no choosing best fold.
metric_contract: R7 extended complete DFL source label metrics with typed pair transitions; evaluate only after independent floodlight agreement. No event data or videos.
decision_gate: M3 gains must not increase completely missed D segment rate or D frame miss rate >.02 on either domain/match compared with M2; no formal competition promotion regardless.
one_shot: All three models declared before any sealed acquisition/score. An exclusive evaluation marker prevents rerunning; no post-holdout model/feature/cost tuning.
source: public IDSSE CC BY4.0 pinned HF mirror; professional league differs from development league, still same provider processing
failure_fallback: Preserve completed per-row results if infrastructure fails; report incomplete evidence without tuning. Existing development results and V3/M1 remain recoverable.
